adaptive_background_guard.evidence: The current mask excludes fine windows intersecting the connected public-threshold island, but adjacent 35-by-35 windows still sample its sub-threshold wings. On exact development inputs, guarding by the existing estimator half-width of 17 pixels reduced median truth-region background error from 0.830575 to 0.315462 RMS for the flat 12-beam mixed case and from 0.313797 to 0.030930 RMS for the varying 8-beam mixed case. Larger 25- and 35-pixel guards were not consistently better and one introduced an extra catalogue row, so no radius is selected by outcome.
adaptive_background_guard.root_cause: Source exclusion was defined only at the detected-island pixels, while the estimator consumes a spatial footprint. Protection therefore ended at a different boundary from the operation it was protecting.

integrated_flux.root_cause: The injected mixed source deliberately places 75% of its total flux in an 8- or 12-beam halo. Its three-sigma truth support is covered, but much of the analytic Gaussian flux lies below that support and outside the source-owned persistent seed plus unchanged 1.5-beam aperture. The retained scale ladder ends at four beams. This is not evidence for globally enlarging production apertures after viewing results.

split_endpoint.root_cause: The lane defined split as total catalogue source count greater than one. In every flagged image, exactly one row lies inside the analytic truth-source bounding box expanded by the predeclared 1.5-major-beam association radius; the other rows are remote faint noise detections. The conservative hierarchy correctly refused to merge unrelated components, so its new terminal-cycle branches remained inactive.

source_owned_measurement_and_parent_repa.evidence: All terminal-cycle missing-child counters are zero; only seven persistent-feature influence parents activate. Persistent source-owned support cannot recover an 8- to 12-beam halo that is absent from the retained four-beam scale support, and unrelated remote detections must not be merged into the injected source.

trigger_executor_and_completeness.evidence: The trigger seam, all 12 Serial/existing-Dask comparisons, product validity, and completeness pass.
